caption_L1: Total number of suicides in Finland from 2007 to 2018 , by age is a line chart. The y-axis shows 40-64 years along linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 500 while the x-axis plots Year using linear scale from 2008 to 2016.
caption_L2L3: And now for some good news, the suicide rate in Finland for the age group of 40-64 years old has decreased steadily in the last 11 years. This rate used to fall at 520 deaths per year in 2008, and in only 8 years it has fallen to just over 300. Of course there are lots to do but this decline is positive and a step in the right direction.
